<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ui_page"><sys_ui_page action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>general</category><client_script>/* CMDB Governance dashboard — client script for UI page x_cmdbgov_app_governance */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  var AJAX = 'x_cmdbgov_app.CMDBGovAjax';
  var DEMO = window.CMDBGOV_DEMO || null;
  var TABS = [
    { id: 'overview', name: 'Overview' },
    { id: 'ownership', name: 'Ownership' },
    { id: 'quality', name: 'Data Quality' },
    { id: 'relationships', name: 'Relationships' },
    { id: 'lifecycle', name: 'Lifecycle & Certification' },
    { id: 'settings', name: 'Settings' }
  ];
  var state = { tab: 'overview', data: null, loading: false, error: '' };
  var root;

  /* ---------------- Utilities ---------------- */

  function esc(v) {
    return String(v === null || v === undefined ? '' : v)
      .replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
      .replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
  }
  function fmt(n) { return n === null || n === undefined ? '—' : Number(n).toLocaleString(); }
  function pct(r) { return r === null || r === undefined ? '—' : (Math.round(r * 1000) / 10) + '%'; }
  function band(score) {
    if (score === null || score === undefined) return 'na';
    return score >= 90 ? 'good' : score >= 75 ? 'fair' : 'poor';
  }
  function bandLabel(score) {
    return { good: 'Healthy', fair: 'Needs attention', poor: 'At risk', na: 'Not scored' }[band(score)];
  }
  function scoreTxt(s) { return s === null || s === undefined ? '—' : (Math.round(s * 10) / 10).toFixed(1); }
  function pillar(id) { return state.data.pillars.filter(function (p) { return p.id === id; })[0]; }

  function ring(score, size, hideText) {
    var r = 42, c = 2 * Math.PI * r;
    var v = score === null || score === undefined ? 0 : Math.max(0, Math.min(100, score));
    var color = { good: '#157347', fair: '#d08a12', poor: '#b42318', na: '#c4cad3' }[band(score)];
    return '<svg class="cg-ring" viewBox="0 0 100 100" role="img" aria-label="Score ' + scoreTxt(score) + '">' +
      '<circle cx="50" cy="50" r="' + r + '" fill="none" stroke="#eef0f3" stroke-width="10"/>' +
      '<circle cx="50" cy="50" r="' + r + '" fill="none" stroke="' + color + '" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"' +
      ' stroke-dasharray="' + (c * v / 100).toFixed(2) + ' ' + c.toFixed(2) + '" transform="rotate(-90 50 50)"/>' +
      (hideText ? '' : '<text x="50" y="50" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central" font-size="' + (size || 24) + '" font-weight="700" fill="#17202b">' +
      (score === null || score === undefined ? '—' : Math.round(score)) + '</text>') + '</svg>';
  }
  function bar(rate) {
    var s = rate === null || rate === undefined ? null : rate * 100;
    return '<div class="cg-bar"><i class="bg-' + band(s) + '" style="width:' + (s === null ? 0 : s.toFixed(1)) + '%"></i></div>';
  }
  function cell(score, attrs) {
    var b = band(score);
    var tag = attrs ? 'button' : 'span';
    return '<' + tag + ' class="cg-cell num soft-' + b + '"' + (attrs || '') + '>' + scoreTxt(score) + '</' + tag + '>';
  }

  /* ---------------- Data ---------------- */

  function call(method, params) {
    if (DEMO) {
      return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
        setTimeout(function () {
          if (method === 'getScorecard') return resolve(DEMO.scorecard);
          if (method === 'testConnection') return resolve({ source: DEMO.scorecard.source, cmdbCiCount: 48210, ms: 212 });
          var key = [params.sysparm_check, params.sysparm_table, params.sysparm_arg || ''].join('|');
          var rec = DEMO.records[key];
          return rec ? resolve(rec) : reject(new Error('No demo data for this drill-down.'));
        }, method === 'getScorecard' ? 450 : 200);
      });
    }
    return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
      var ga = new GlideAjax(AJAX);
      ga.addParam('sysparm_name', method);
      Object.keys(params || {}).forEach(function (k) { ga.addParam(k, params[k]); });
      ga.getXMLAnswer(function (answer) {
        var res;
        try { res = JSON.parse(answer); } catch (e) {
          return reject(new Error('Unexpected response from server. Check that the CMDBGovAjax script include is client callable.'));
        }
        if (res && res.ok) resolve(res.data); else reject(new Error((res && res.error) || 'Request failed'));
      });
    });
  }

  function load() {
    state.loading = true; state.error = '';
    render();
    call('getScorecard', {}).then(function (d) {
      state.data = d; state.loading = false; render();
    }, function (e) {
      state.loading = false; state.error = e.message; render();
    });
  }

  /* ---------------- Layout ---------------- */

  function render() {
    var d = state.data;
    var h = '';
    var src = d ? d.source : null;
    var srcHtml = '';
    if (DEMO) srcHtml = '<span class="cg-pill"><span class="cg-dot demo"></span>Demo data</span>';
    else if (src) srcHtml = '<span class="cg-pill"><span class="cg-dot ' + (src.mode === 'remote' ? 'remote' : '') + '"></span>' +
      (src.mode === 'remote' ? 'Remote · ' + esc(src.instance.replace(/^https?:\/\//, '').replace(/\/$/, '')) + ' · ' + (src.authType === 'oauth2' ? 'OAuth 2.0' : 'Basic auth')
        : 'This instance') + '</span>';

    h += '<header class="cg-head"><div class="cg-brand"><div class="cg-mark">CG</div><div>' +
      '<h1 class="cg-title">CMDB Governance</h1><p class="cg-sub">Phase 1 · Read-only assessment</p></div></div>' +
      srcHtml +
      (d ? '<span class="cg-meta">Run ' + esc(d.generatedAt) + ' · ' + (d.durationMs / 1000).toFixed(1) + 's</span>' : '') +
      '<button class="cg-btn primary" data-act="refresh"' + (state.loading ? ' disabled' : '') + '>' + (state.loading ? 'Running…' : 'Run assessment') + '</button></header>';

    h += '<nav class="cg-tabs" role="tablist">';
    TABS.forEach(function (t) {
      var chip = '';
      if (d && t.id !== 'overview' && t.id !== 'settings') {
        var p = pillar(t.id);
        if (p) chip = '<span class="cg-chipscore num soft-' + band(p.score) + '">' + scoreTxt(p.score) + '</span>';
      }
      h += '<button class="cg-tab' + (state.tab === t.id ? ' on' : '') + '" role="tab" data-tab="' + t.id + '">' + esc(t.name) + chip + '</button>';
    });
    h += '</nav><main class="cg-main">';

    if (state.error) h += '<div class="cg-banner err"><b>Could not run the assessment.</b> ' + esc(state.error) + '</div>';
    if (!d && state.loading) h += '<div class="cg-loading"><div class="cg-spin"></div>Evaluating governance checks across the CMDB…</div>';
    else if (d) {
      if (d.warnings && d.warnings.length) h += '<div class="cg-banner"><b>Heads up</b><ul>' + d.warnings.map(function (w) { return '<li>' + esc(w) + '</li>'; }).join('') + '</ul></div>';
      if (state.tab === 'overview') h += viewOverview(d);
      else if (state.tab === 'settings') h += viewSettings(d);
      else h += viewPillar(d, pillar(state.tab));
    }
    h += '</main><div id="cg-drawer-host"></div>';
    root.innerHTML = h;
  }

  /* ---------------- Overview ---------------- */

  function viewOverview(d) {
    var h = '<section class="cg-section"><div class="cg-hero">';
    h += '<div class="cg-card cg-overall"><div class="cg-overall-top">' + ring(d.overall, 26, true) +
      '<div><div class="cg-ring-label">Governance score</div><div class="cg-ring-big num ' + band(d.overall) + '">' + scoreTxt(d.overall) + '</div>' +
      '<div class="cg-ring-band ' + band(d.overall) + '">' + bandLabel(d.overall) + '</div></div></div>' +
      '<div class="cg-kpis"><div><div class="cg-kpi-v num">' + fmt(d.totals.cis) + '</div><div class="cg-kpi-l">CIs governed</div></div>' +
      '<div><div class="cg-kpi-v num">' + fmt(d.totals.classes) + '</div><div class="cg-kpi-l">CI classes</div></div></div></div>';

    h += '<div class="cg-pillars">';
    d.pillars.forEach(function (p) {
      var worst = p.checks.filter(function (c) { return c.passRate !== null; })
        .sort(function (a, b) { return a.passRate - b.passRate; })[0];
      h += '<button class="cg-pillar" data-tab="' + p.id + '"><div class="cg-pillar-name">' + esc(p.name) + '</div>' +
        '<div class="cg-pillar-score num ' + band(p.score) + '">' + scoreTxt(p.score) + '</div>' +
        bar(p.score === null ? null : p.score / 100) +
        '<div class="cg-pillar-desc" style="margin-top:10px">' + esc(p.description) + '</div>' +
        (worst ? '<div class="cg-pillar-worst">Weakest: <b>' + esc(worst.name) + '</b> · ' + pct(worst.passRate) + ' pass</div>' : '') +
        '</button>';
    });
    h += '</div></div></section>';

    h += '<section class="cg-section"><h2 class="cg-h2">Top issues<small>Largest gaps weighted by severity — click to see the records</small></h2>';
    if (!d.topIssues.length) h += '<div class="cg-card cg-empty">No failing checks. Nice work.</div>';
    else {
      h += '<div class="cg-card cg-tablewrap"><table class="cg-table"><thead><tr><th>Issue</th><th>Area</th><th>Class</th><th>Severity</th><th class="r">Failing</th><th class="r">Pass rate</th><th style="width:140px"></th></tr></thead><tbody>';
      d.topIssues.forEach(function (i) {
        var p = pillar(i.pillar);
        var drill = i.checkId === 'completeness' ? ' data-tab="quality"' : ' data-drill="' + esc(i.checkId) + '" data-table="' + esc(i.table) + '"';
        h += '<tr class="click"' + drill + '><td><b>' + esc(i.name) + '</b></td><td class="cg-muted">' + esc(p ? p.name : i.pillar) + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + esc(i.label) + '</td><td><span class="cg-sev ' + i.severity + '">' + i.severity + '</span></td>' +
          '<td class="r num"><b>' + fmt(i.failCount) + '</b> <span class="cg-muted">/ ' + fmt(i.total) + '</span></td>' +
          '<td class="r num ' + band(i.passRate * 100) + '">' + pct(i.passRate) + '</td><td>' + bar(i.passRate) + '</td></tr>';
      });
      h += '</tbody></table></div>';
    }
    h += '</section>';

    h += '<section class="cg-section"><h2 class="cg-h2">Scorecard by CI class</h2><div class="cg-card cg-tablewrap"><table class="cg-table"><thead><tr><th>Class</th><th class="r">CIs</th>';
    d.pillars.forEach(function (p) { h += '<th class="c">' + esc(p.name) + '</th>'; });
    h += '<th class="c">Overall</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
    d.byClass.forEach(function (c) {
      h += '<tr><td><b>' + esc(c.label) + '</b><div class="cg-muted cg-small">' + esc(c.table) + '</div></td><td class="r num">' + fmt(c.total) + '</td>';
      d.pillars.forEach(function (p) { h += '<td class="c">' + cell(c.pillars[p.id], ' data-tab="' + p.id + '" title="Open ' + esc(p.name) + '"') + '</td>'; });
      h += '<td class="c">' + cell(c.overall) + '</td></tr>';
    });
    h += '</tbody></table></div></section>';
    return h;
  }

  /* ---------------- Pillar ---------------- */

  function viewPillar(d, p) {
    var h = '<section class="cg-section"><div class="cg-card cg-phead">' + ring(p.score, 26) +
      '<div><h3>' + esc(p.name) + ' <span class="cg-ring-band ' + band(p.score) + '" style="font-size:13px;margin-left:6px">' + bandLabel(p.score) + '</span></h3>' +
      '<p>' + esc(p.description) + '</p><p class="cg-small cg-muted">Weighted ' + p.weight + '% of the overall score · ' + p.checks.length + ' checks</p></div></div></section>';

    var metrics = p.metrics.filter(function (m) { return m.status !== 'n/a'; });
    if (metrics.length) {
      h += '<section class="cg-section"><h2 class="cg-h2">Instance metrics<small>Context only, not scored</small></h2><div class="cg-metrics">';
      metrics.forEach(function (m) {
        var val = m.status === 'error' ? '<span class="cg-muted cg-small">Unavailable</span>' : fmt(m.value);
        var cls = m.bad && m.value > 0 ? ' poor' : '';
        h += '<div class="cg-card cg-metric"><div class="cg-metric-l">' + esc(m.name) + '</div><div class="cg-metric-v num' + cls + '">' + val + '</div>' +
          '<div class="cg-metric-d">' + esc(m.status === 'error' ? m.error : m.description) + '</div>' +
          (m.listUrl ? '<div class="cg-small" style="margin-top:6px"><a href="' + esc(m.listUrl) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open list ↗</a></div>' : '') + '</div>';
      });
      h += '</div></section>';
    }

    h += '<section class="cg-section"><h2 class="cg-h2">Checks</h2>';
    p.checks.forEach(function (c) { h += viewCheck(c); });
    h += '</section>';
    return h;
  }

  function viewCheck(c) {
    var statusTag = c.status === 'n/a' ? '<span class="cg-tag">Not applicable</span>' :
      c.status === 'error' ? '<span class="cg-tag" style="background:#fde7e4;color:#b42318">Error</span>' :
      c.status === 'partial' ? '<span class="cg-tag">Partial</span>' : '';
    var h = '<div class="cg-card cg-check"><div class="cg-check-top"><div>' +
      '<div class="cg-check-name">' + esc(c.name) + ' <span class="cg-sev ' + c.severity + '">' + c.severity + '</span> ' + statusTag + '</div>' +
      '<div class="cg-check-desc">' + esc(c.description) + '</div>' +
      (c.status === 'error' ? '<div class="cg-check-desc poor" style="margin-top:6px">' + esc(c.error) + '</div>' : '') +
      '</div><div class="cg-check-stat">';
    if (c.passRate !== null) {
      h += '<div class="big num ' + band(c.passRate * 100) + '">' + pct(c.passRate) + '</div><div class="of num">' +
        (c.type === 'completeness' ? fmt(c.failCount) + ' empty values of ' + fmt(c.total) : fmt(c.failCount) + ' failing of ' + fmt(c.total)) + '</div>' + bar(c.passRate);
    } else h += '<div class="big na">—</div>';
    h += '</div></div>';

    if (c.type === 'completeness') h += viewCompleteness(c);
    else {
      h += '<div class="cg-classes">';
      c.perClass.forEach(function (pc) {
        if (pc.status !== 'ok') {
          h += '<span class="cg-classchip dim" title="' + esc(pc.error || 'Not applicable to this class') + '">' + esc(pc.label) + ' · ' + (pc.status === 'error' ? 'error' : 'n/a') + '</span>';
          return;
        }
        var extra = c.type === 'duplicates' && pc.groups ? ' <span class="cg-muted">(' + fmt(pc.groups) + ' names' + (pc.truncated ? '+' : '') + ')</span>' : '';
        var attrs = pc.failCount > 0 ? ' data-drill="' + esc(c.id) + '" data-table="' + esc(pc.table) + '"' : '';
        var tag = pc.failCount > 0 ? 'button' : 'span';
        h += '<' + tag + ' class="cg-classchip"' + attrs + '>' + esc(pc.label) + ' <b class="num ' + (pc.failCount > 0 ? band(pc.passRate * 100) : 'good') + '">' + fmt(pc.failCount) + '</b>' + extra + '</' + tag + '>';
      });
      h += '</div>';
    }
    h += '<div class="cg-rec"><b>Recommended action:</b> ' + esc(c.recommendation) + '</div></div>';
    return h;
  }

  function viewCompleteness(c) {
    var byTable = {};
    var order = [];
    (c.details || []).forEach(function (dd) {
      if (!byTable[dd.table]) { byTable[dd.table] = { label: dd.label, rows: [] }; order.push(dd.table); }
      byTable[dd.table].rows.push(dd);
    });
    if (!order.length) return '';
    var h = '<div class="cg-matrix cg-tablewrap"><table class="cg-table"><thead><tr><th>Class</th><th>Field</th><th class="r">Empty</th><th class="r">Populated</th><th style="width:160px"></th></tr></thead><tbody>';
    order.forEach(function (t) {
      var g = byTable[t];
      g.rows.forEach(function (r, i) {
        var attrs = r.empty > 0 ? ' class="click" data-drill="completeness" data-table="' + esc(t) + '" data-arg="' + esc(r.field) + '"' : '';
        h += '<tr' + attrs + '>' + (i === 0 ? '<td rowspan="' + g.rows.length + '" style="vertical-align:top"><b>' + esc(g.label) + '</b></td>' : '') +
          '<td><code>' + esc(r.field) + '</code></td><td class="r num">' + fmt(r.empty) + '</td>' +
          '<td class="r num ' + band(r.populated === null ? null : r.populated * 100) + '">' + pct(r.populated) + '</td><td>' + bar(r.populated) + '</td></tr>';
      });
    });
    return h + '</tbody></table></div>';
  }

  /* ---------------- Settings ---------------- */

  function viewSettings(d) {
    var s = d.settings;
    var req = s.required || {};
    var h = '<section class="cg-section"><h2 class="cg-h2">Connection</h2><div class="cg-card"><div class="cg-kv">' +
      '<div>Data source</div><div>' + (s.dataSource === 'remote' ? 'Remote instance' : 'This instance (direct, read-only)') + '</div>';
    if (s.dataSource === 'remote') {
      h += '<div>Instance URL</div><div>' + esc(s.remoteUrl) + '</div>' +
        '<div>Authentication</div><div>' + (s.authType === 'oauth2' ? 'OAuth 2.0 profile' : 'Basic auth profile') + '</div>' +
        '<div>Profile sys_id</div><div><code>' + esc(s.authProfile) + '</code></div>';
    }
    h += '<div>Connection test</div><div><button class="cg-btn" data-act="test">Test connection</button> <span id="cg-test" class="cg-small cg-muted" style="margin-left:8px"></span></div>' +
      '</div></div></section>';

    h += '<section class="cg-section"><h2 class="cg-h2">Assessment scope</h2><div class="cg-card"><div class="cg-kv">' +
      '<div>CI classes</div><div>' + s.classes.map(function (c) { return '<code>' + esc(c) + '</code>'; }).join(' ') + '</div>' +
      '<div>Scope filter</div><div><code>' + esc(s.scopeQuery || '(none)') + '</code></div>' +
      '<div>Staleness window</div><div>' + s.staleDays + ' days (before ' + esc(s.staleDate) + ' UTC)</div>' +
      '</div></div></section>';

    h += '<section class="cg-section"><h2 class="cg-h2">Required fields</h2><div class="cg-card cg-tablewrap"><table class="cg-table"><thead><tr><th>Applies to</th><th>Fields</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
    Object.keys(req).forEach(function (k) {
      h += '<tr><td>' + (k === '_default' ? '<b>All classes</b>' : '<code>' + esc(k) + '</code>') + '</td><td>' +
        (req[k] || []).map(function (f) { return '<code>' + esc(f) + '</code>'; }).join(' ') + '</td></tr>';
    });
    h += '</tbody></table></div></section>';

    h += '<section class="cg-section"><h2 class="cg-h2">Changing settings</h2><div class="cg-card" style="padding:16px 18px;font-size:13px;color:#4a5565">' +
      'Settings are system properties prefixed <code>x_cmdbgov_app.</code> (role <code>x_cmdbgov_app.admin</code>). ' +
      (DEMO ? '' : '<a href="sys_properties_list.do?sysparm_query=nameSTARTSWITHx_cmdbgov_app." target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open CMDB Governance properties ↗</a>') +
      ' Re-run the assessment after changing them.</div></section>';
    return h;
  }

  /* ---------------- Drawer (drill-down) ---------------- */

  function closeDrawer() {
    var host = document.getElementById('cg-drawer-host');
    if (host) host.innerHTML = '';
  }

  function openDrawer(checkId, table, arg) {
    var host = document.getElementById('cg-drawer-host');
    var check = null;
    state.data.pillars.forEach(function (p) { p.checks.forEach(function (c) { if (c.id === checkId) check = c; }); });
    var title = (check ? check.name : checkId) + (arg ? ' · ' + arg : '');
    var label = table;
    state.data.classes.forEach(function (c) { if (c.table === table) label = c.label; });

    function shell(body, foot) {
      host.innerHTML = '<div class="cg-scrim" data-act="close"></div><aside class="cg-drawer" role="dialog" aria-label="' + esc(title) + '">' +
        '<div class="cg-drawer-head"><div><h3>' + esc(title) + '</h3><p>' + esc(label) + ' · <code>' + esc(table) + '</code></p></div>' +
        '<button class="cg-x" data-act="close" aria-label="Close">×</button></div>' +
        '<div class="cg-drawer-body">' + body + '</div>' + (foot ? '<div class="cg-drawer-foot">' + foot + '</div>' : '') + '</aside>';
    }
    shell('<div class="cg-loading"><div class="cg-spin"></div>Loading records…</div>');

    call('getRecords', { sysparm_check: checkId, sysparm_table: table, sysparm_arg: arg || '' }).then(function (r) {
      if (r.kind === 'groups') {
        var b = '<table class="cg-table"><thead><tr><th>Name</th><th class="r">CIs sharing it</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>';
        r.groups.forEach(function (g) {
          b += '<tr class="click" data-drill="duplicates" data-table="' + esc(table) + '" data-arg="' + esc(g.value) + '"><td><b>' + esc(g.display) + '</b></td><td class="r num">' + fmt(g.count) + '</td>' +
            '<td class="r"><a href="' + esc(g.listUrl) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener" data-stop="1">Open ↗</a></td></tr>';
        });
        b += '</tbody></table>';
        shell(r.groups.length ? b : '<div class="cg-empty">No duplicate names.</div>',
          '<span>' + fmt(r.groups.length) + ' duplicate names shown. Click a name to see its CIs.</span>');
        return;
      }
      var labels = { name: 'Name', sys_class_name: 'Class', owned_by: 'Owned by', support_group: 'Support group', managed_by_group: 'Managed by group',
        install_status: 'Install status', operational_status: 'Operational status', discovery_source: 'Discovery source',
        last_discovered: 'Last discovered', sys_updated_on: 'Updated' };
      var focus = (r.focus || []).concat(arg ? [arg] : []);
      var b2 = '<div class="cg-tablewrap"><table class="cg-table"><thead><tr>';
      r.fields.forEach(function (f) { b2 += '<th' + (focus.indexOf(f) >= 0 ? ' class="focus"' : '') + '>' + esc(labels[f] || f) + '</th>'; });
      b2 += '</tr></thead><tbody>';
      r.rows.forEach(function (row) {
        b2 += '<tr>';
        r.fields.forEach(function (f, i) {
          var v = row[f] ? row[f].display : '';
          var content = v ? esc(v) : '<span class="cg-muted">empty</span>';
          b2 += '<td' + (focus.indexOf(f) >= 0 ? ' class="focus"' : '') + '>' + (i === 0 ? '<a href="' + esc(row.url) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">' + content + '</a>' : content) + '</td>';
        });
        b2 += '</tr>';
      });
      b2 += '</tbody></table></div>';
      shell(r.rows.length ? b2 : '<div class="cg-empty">No records match.</div>',
        '<span class="num">Showing ' + fmt(r.rows.length) + ' of ' + fmt(r.total) + ' · most recently updated first</span>' +
        '<a class="cg-btn" href="' + esc(r.listUrl) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open full list in ServiceNow ↗</a>');
    }, function (e) {
      shell('<div class="cg-banner err" style="margin:20px">' + esc(e.message) + '</div>');
    });
  }

  /* ---------------- Events ---------------- */

  function onClick(ev) {
    var el = ev.target;
    if (el.closest && el.closest('[data-stop]')) return;
    var t = el.closest ? el.closest('[data-tab],[data-drill],[data-act]') : null;
    if (!t || !root.contains(t)) return;
    if (t.getAttribute('data-act') === 'refresh') { load(); return; }
    if (t.getAttribute('data-act') === 'close') { closeDrawer(); return; }
    if (t.getAttribute('data-act') === 'test') { testConnection(); return; }
    if (t.hasAttribute('data-drill')) {
      openDrawer(t.getAttribute('data-drill'), t.getAttribute('data-table'), t.getAttribute('data-arg') || '');
      return;
    }
    if (t.hasAttribute('data-tab')) {
      state.tab = t.getAttribute('data-tab');
      render();
      window.scrollTo(0, 0);
    }
  }

  function testConnection() {
    var out = document.getElementById('cg-test');
    out.textContent = 'Testing…';
    call('testConnection', {}).then(function (r) {
      out.innerHTML = '<span class="good">✓ Connected</span> · ' + fmt(r.cmdbCiCount) + ' CIs in cmdb_ci · ' + r.ms + ' ms';
    }, function (e) {
      out.innerHTML = '<span class="poor">✕ ' + esc(e.message) + '</span>';
    });
  }

  function start() {
    root = document.getElementById('cg');
    if (!root) return;
    root.addEventListener('click', onClick);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Escape') closeDrawer(); });
    load();
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', start);
  else start();
})();
